# Third-party notices

- `names.js` contains the first-name and surname lists from [Life-Simulator1](https://github.com/fungamer2-2/Life-Simulator1), commit `46d69c02b1196a4e01b8dbc1a1cf107a7252a107`. Its MIT copyright and permission notice is in `life-simulator1/LICENSE`.
- The selectable diet feature and diet categories are adapted and rebalanced from [OpenLife](https://codeberg.org/OpenLife/OpenLife), commit `9034077e32`. Its MIT copyright and permission notice is in `openlife/LICENSE`.

The projects are Python console applications. Their full codebases have not been included or ported into the browser game. Robert1811's life-simulator repository has no license file or GitHub license metadata as of this change; it was used for gameplay inspiration only, not copied.
